Model Text Summary:
A courtly drama in which four observant brothers—Shiv Datt, Ram Datt, Dev Datt, and Har Datt—are accused of stealing a merchant's lost camel because they describe its physical ailments and cargo with uncanny precision. Brought before the King of Ujjain, they reveal that they never saw the camel; rather, they deduced its condition (lameness, one-blind eye, missing tooth, cargo of honey and wheat) by scrutinizing tracks, eaten leaves, and insect activity along the road. Impressed, the King exonerates them and appoints them royal advisers.
